judged_text: The members template iterates {{#each m in members}}, but after this diff removed afterModel and _members from group-members.js.es6, nothing ever sets a 'members' property on the members controller — findMembers stores members on the group model, not the members-route controller. The user-facing group members page (route group.members) renders an empty table for every group, because 'members' resolves to undefined on the members controller; admins can see the list but regular users navigating /groups/:name/members get nothing.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `group-members` route to set `controller.model` to the group (`setupController(controller, model) { controller.set('model', model); model.findMembers(); }`). In parallel, `Discourse.Group#findMembers` was changed to set a `members` property on the *group model* via `self.setProperties({ ..., members: ... })`. So it’s not true that “nothing ever sets a `members` property” — it’s set on the model. Whether `{{#each m in members}}` resolves depends on controller/template binding (e.g., ObjectController-style proxying), which is not shown in this diff, so the claimed guaranteed empty rendering for all groups can’t be verified from the diff alone.
